styleLock: Xenovoya final production art: handcrafted layered paper-cut miniature diorama with painterly mineral textures, subtle fiber edges, sculpted geological relief, tactile weathered basalt, restrained expedition technology, and deep atmospheric parallax. Light behaves as information: cyan reveals, gold invites, green reassures, red warns, violet marks the rare. One unmistakable focal event, strong silhouette, quiet negative space, premium game key-art finish. Not photorealistic and not flat vector art.
reviewPolicy: Every promoted asset was inspected individually or on a labeled contact sheet; identity edits were compared against canonical character references; transparent relics were reviewed on a dark field.

rejectedEvidence.reason: The first candidate read as a monumental portal rather than a backpack-scale relic chamber.
